observations: A single wheeled/folding-arm salon-style hooded hair dryer unit, with a blue-tinted plastic dome hood and grey plastic arms/stand, shown from three angles.
Photo 2 shows the hood separated from the arm assembly, with a cord visible leading from the hood into the arm/stand area.
No brand name, model number, or control panel/dial markings are legible in any photo.
Surface shows general wear (scuffs, smudges) consistent with used equipment; no visible cracks but the plastic has worn patches.
Cord is visible but no plug head is shown in any photo.
No photo shows the unit powered on, no heat/steam output, no control panel close-up.

claims.evidence: Photos show one hooded unit; no label or demonstration distinguishes dryer-only vs combined dryer/steamer function, and no power-on or steam/heat output is shown.

risks.risk: Unit may not power on or heat/blow air at all
risks.proof: Video clip of unit plugged in, hood lit/warm, air or steam visibly emitting

risks.risk: Steam function (if present) may be absent or broken, separate from dryer function
risks.proof: Close-up of control panel/dial showing a steam setting, plus a clip showing steam output
risks.if_unproven: priced as dryer-only, non-functional, since steam claim cannot be verified

risks.risk: Cord/plug condition unknown (fraying, missing plug, rewiring)
risks.proof: Clear photo of the full cord length and plug head
risks.if_unproven: priced as needing electrical inspection/possible rewiring

risks.risk: Folding arm/stand mechanism may be loose, cracked, or unstable
risks.proof: Photo/video of the stand fully extended and the hood being raised/lowered

risks.risk: Internal heating element or fan condition unverifiable from photos
risks.proof: Video of unit running with audible fan/heat check
risks.if_unproven: priced as worst case, non-functional internals

proof_requests: Video of the unit plugged in and switched on, showing air/heat and steam (if claimed) being produced
Close-up of the control panel/dial and any brand/model label
Photo of the full power cord and plug head
Photo/video of the stand being raised, lowered, and folded to check mechanical stability
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable by type as a used salon-style hooded hairdryer/steamer unit, but with no demonstration of power-on function, heat, or steam output, it must be priced at worst case as non-functional until proof is provided.
